description_zh: 通过本接口，可以新增时间条件设置配置
name: CloudCreateEnterpriseTime

parameters.description_en: The ID of the call center.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the call center
parameters.name: enterprise_id

parameters.description_en: The name of the time condition. The name must be unique within the same call center.
parameters.description_zh: 时间条件名称；同一呼叫中心下不能重复
parameters.help_en: The name of the time condition. The name must be unique within the same call center
parameters.help_zh: 时间条件名称；同一呼叫中心下不能重复
parameters.name: name

parameters.description_en: The priority of the time condition. The priority must be unique within the same call center. The minimum value is 1. A smaller value indicates a higher priority.
parameters.description_zh: 时间条件优先级；同一呼叫中心下不能重复，值从1开始，值越小优先级越高
parameters.help_en: The priority of the time condition. The priority must be unique within the same call center. The minimum value is 1. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
parameters.help_zh: 时间条件优先级；同一呼叫中心下不能重复，值从1开始，值越小优先级越高
parameters.name: priority

parameters.description_en: The condition type. Valid values: `1` (By day of the week) and `2` (By a fixed date range).
parameters.description_zh: 条件类型 1:按照星期配置 2:按照固定时间配置
parameters.help_en: The condition type. Valid values: `1` (By day of the week) and `2` (By a fixed date range)
parameters.help_zh: 条件类型 1:按照星期配置 2:按照固定时间配置
parameters.name: type

parameters.description_en: The time type. Valid values: `1` (Continuous) and `2` (Interval).
parameters.help_en: The time type. Valid values: `1` (Continuous) and `2` (Interval)
parameters.name: time_type

parameters.description_en: The start date. This parameter is required when `Type` is set to `2`. The value must be in the `YYYY-MM-DD` format. If `Type` is set to `1`, pass an empty string. The value of `FromDay` cannot be later than the value of `ToDay`.
parameters.description_zh: 起始日期；当type=2 时必选，格式为：yyyy-MM-dd 、type=1时为空串 fromDay不能大于toDay
parameters.help_en: The start date. This parameter is required when `Type` is set to `2`. The value must be in the `YYYY-MM-DD` format. If `Type` is set to `1`, pass an empty string. The value of `FromDay` cannot be later than the value of `ToDay`
parameters.help_zh: 起始日期；当type=2 时必选，格式为：yyyy-MM-dd 、type=1时为空串 fromDay不能大于toDay
parameters.name: from_day

parameters.description_en: The end date. This parameter is required when `Type` is set to `2`. The value must be in the `YYYY-MM-DD` format. If `Type` is set to `1`, pass an empty string. The value of `ToDay` cannot be earlier than the value of `FromDay`.
parameters.description_zh: 终止日期；当type=2 时必选，格式为：yyyy-MM-dd 、type=1时为空串 fromDay不能大于toDay
parameters.help_en: The end date. This parameter is required when `Type` is set to `2`. The value must be in the `YYYY-MM-DD` format. If `Type` is set to `1`, pass an empty string. The value of `ToDay` cannot be earlier than the value of `FromDay`
parameters.help_zh: 终止日期；当type=2 时必选，格式为：yyyy-MM-dd 、type=1时为空串 fromDay不能大于toDay
parameters.name: to_day

parameters.description_en: This parameter is required when `Type` is set to `1`. Specifies the days of the week. Valid values: Monday=`2`, Tuesday=`3`, Wednesday=`4`, Thursday=`5`, Friday=`6`, Saturday=`7`, and Sunday=`1`. Separate multiple values with commas (,), for example, `2,3,4`. If `Type` is set to `2`, pass an empty string.
parameters.description_zh: 当type=1 时必选,周一：2、周二：3、周三：4、周四：5、周五：6、周六：7、周日：1。星期值以,分隔 例如： 2,3,4代表周一周二周三、type=2时为空串
parameters.help_en: This parameter is required when `Type` is set to `1`. Specifies the days of the week. Valid values: Monday=`2`, Tuesday=`3`, Wednesday=`4`, Thursday=`5`, Friday=`6`, Saturday=`7`, and Sunday=`1`. Separate multiple values with commas (,), for example, `2,3,4`. If `Type` is set to `2`, pass an empty string
parameters.help_zh: 当type=1 时必选,周一：2、周二：3、周三：4、周四：5、周五：6、周六：7、周日：1。星期值以,分隔 例如： 2,3,4代表周一周二周三、type=2时为空串
parameters.name: day_of_week

parameters.description_en: The start time in the `HH:mm` format. For example, `06:00`. The value of `StartTime` cannot be later than the value of `EndTime`.
parameters.description_zh: 开始时间；格式为 HH:mm 例如、 06:00 startTime不能大于endTime
parameters.help_en: The start time in the `HH:mm` format. For example, `06:00`. The value of `StartTime` cannot be later than the value of `EndTime`
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间；格式为 HH:mm 例如、 06:00 startTime不能大于endTime
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.description_en: The end time in the `HH:mm` format. For example, `19:00`. The value of `EndTime` cannot be earlier than the value of `StartTime`.
parameters.description_zh: 结束时间；格式为 HH:mm 例如、 19:00 startTime不能大于endTime
parameters.help_en: The end time in the `HH:mm` format. For example, `19:00`. The value of `EndTime` cannot be earlier than the value of `StartTime`
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间；格式为 HH:mm 例如、 19:00 startTime不能大于endTime
parameters.name: end_time
